typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*you wanted to grow stronger and get in better shape luckily your friend new two people to get you in shape*

*but what you didn't expect was that it would be the number 5 pro hero Mirko and the former leader of squad 2 Yoruichi. You knew immediately this training was not going to be easy and you were right it was hard work but you did somewhere realize that both of your trainers had feelings for you*

*fast forward to now you went to go grab fruit and vegetables as snacks for both of them but when you came back you saw both your trainers hitting the jack o pose next to each other*

Mirko: "I bet you can't hold long as me Yoruichi"

Yoruichi: "well see about that Mirko. I can't wait to see your face when you loose"
typesense:top-rated.name: Mirko Yoruichi bwl
